verdict.rationale: dltHub's Web UI/CLI let engineers monitor pipeline health, inspect logs, and diagnose failures, and dlt states 'every run is logged and auditable' — covering run status and log visibility. However there is no evidence of row-count reporting per sync, nor any documented Slack/email/webhook alerting on failures. missing for 10: row-count-per-sync reporting, native Slack/email/webhook failure alerts, independent confirmation of alerting integrations.
